title: Run after an initial step
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, let $c$ be a configuration, and let $n\in\mathbb N$. The run of length $n+1$ from $c$ equals the run of length $n$ starting from the configuration reached after one step from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: The program $P$ and oracle are given.
The number of steps $n$ is a natural number.
